definitions.explanation: A parent's cutting off a child, especially a son, from the family: refusing to see or support them because of their behavior. In the Edo period it was a formal legal act; today it is a strong but informal way of breaking off relations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勘当|かんどう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勘当|かんどう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was disowned by my parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家業|かぎょう}→家業：12353_kagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}が→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}ったら→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{勘当|かんどう}だ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{怒鳴|どな}られた→怒鳴る：05340_donaru⟧。
examples.english: When I said I would become an actor instead of taking over the family business, my father shouted that I was disowned.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{勘当|かんどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is transitive (the child takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧); the child's side is the passive {勘当|かんどう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勘当|かんどう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be disowned
- {勘当|かんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to take back the disowning, to forgive
- 「{勘当|かんどう}だ！」: "You're no son of mine!"

WATCH OUT:
It has the same reading as ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧ (being moved, emotion), a very common word; the context makes it clear.
